— Wave 0: Foundation (attempt 2) — canon + art direction + engine + vertical slice —
Art direction locked (9 shoot-look-fix rounds): warm toon village meadow, 76 draw calls, 120fps → docs/ART-DIRECTION.md
Canon keeper: docs/CANON.md written (7k words), reconciling the six bibles…
User asked for more sub-agents → opening a parallel wave: music, SFX+mixer, battle rules (no dependency on the engine being built).

Canon pass: docs/CANON.md is the single source of truth; all six bibles reconciled (Bram, Willow, Sera, Barty, Bobble, Pip, Mortmain, Puddlewick, Cobwell Manor, Ambergarde); added DQV beats B11b sabre-cat reunion, Papa's Letter, wagon return, ship, Malgrim.
F1 engine spine verified (32/32 asserts). F2 input, F4 DQ window, F5 save built; F3 art foundation finishing.
P28 SFX first critic round: 62 — gap: sword hits are sub-150Hz thuds that vanish on laptop speakers. Builder fixing.

Integrator: first vertical slice — boots into Puddlewick Vale (meadow map, spring/orbit camera with occlusion, circle collision w/ sliding + corner assist, placeholder Bram, F4 signpost dialogue). scenarios/slice.json passes: 0 errors, ~120 fps, ~130-145k tris, <230 calls.
Vertical slice integrated: boots into Puddlewick Vale, walkable, signpost dialogue. Blind critics (look, feel) judging now.
Critic r1: P14 battle rules 50, P19 growth 45 (difficulty flat then a wall; levels don't matter), P27 music 56 (strings/horns sound like filtered saws), P28 SFX 62→62 (hits lack a transient snap).
